description:
[EU MDR Article 87 vigilance incident reporting statutory deadlines calculator. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Calculates strict statutory notification deadlines under Regulation (EU) 2017/745 Article 87 (public health threat: 2 days; death/deterioration: 10 days; serious incidents: 15 days) and prepares initial MIR vigilance report payloads.
Usage: Pass incident awareness date and severity classification to compute exact deadline dates and EUDAMED notification requirements.
Returns: JSON object with { incidentReferenceId: string, incidentSeverityType: string, statutoryDeadlineDays: number, dateOfIncidentAwarenessIso: string, statutoryDeadlineDateIso: string, isImmediateNotificationMandatory: boolean, eudamedReportingFormType: string, initialReportRequiredContent: object }.

dateOfIncidentAwarenessIso.description: Date when manufacturer first became aware of the incident (YYYY-MM-DD)

deviceName.description: Commercial name and model of the medical device involved

incidentReferenceId.description: Internal complaint or vigilance file reference identifier

incidentSeverityType.description: Incident severity category ex MDR Article 87(3)-(5)

isDeviceCausalRelationshipEstablishedOrS.description: Whether a causal link between device and incident is established or reasonably possible

isFieldSafetyCorrectiveActionPlanned.description: Whether a Field Safety Corrective Action (FSCA) and Field Safety Notice (FSN) are being initiated (Art. 87(8))

manufacturerName.description: Legal name of the manufacturer or EU Authorized Representative

reportingToMemberStateCompetentAuthority.description: 2-letter ISO country code of national competent authority receiving notification

name: mdr_vigilance_reporting_timeline_calculator
